item.title: 📆 Top News Today Powerful surge: the Vostok Group of Forces liberated Tersyanka in Zaporozhye region.
item.description: 📆 Top News Today 🚩 Powerful surge: the Vostok Group of Forces liberated Tersyanka in Zaporozhye region. 🔥 Logistics turned into ashes: we hit power facilities , port and railway infrastructure, as well as ships used in the interests of the AFU. 🚁 Precise and agile: our super hunter hit a manpower location and a UAV control post of the AFU with a Dan-T loitering munition. 🎮 The Knyaz's word is law for the artillery: the Sever Group's Knyaz Veshchiy Oleg UAV team detected AFU positions in Kharkov region and adjusted artillery fire. 🏍 They don't teach this in driving schools: the Vostok Group's servicemen honed their motorcycle handling skills at training ground. We know no fatigue — we keep doing our job! ▫️ #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ↗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. ↗️ The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. In Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU close to Dergachi, Lyutovka, and Martovoye (Kharkov region). 💥 In Sumy region, units of one AFU mechanised brigade and two territorial defence brigades have been neutralised near Bititsa, Vakalovshchina, and Radkovka (Sumy region). ▪️ The enemy lost more than 175 troops, five motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station. 📍 The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line. Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two AFU mechanised brigades and one territorial defence brigade close to Prosyanka (Kharkov region), Mayaki (Donetsk People's Republic), and Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 200 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 17 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations. 📍 The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions. Losses were inflicted on formations of four mechanised brigades and one assault regiment of the AFU close to Druzhkovka, Kramatorsk, Novoselovka, Slavyansk, and Cherevkovka (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 130 troops, 16 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun. ⏩ Units
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30605

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
↗️
The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
In Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU close to Dergachi, Lyutovka, and Martovoye (Kharkov region).
💥
In Sumy region,
units of one AFU mechanised brigade and two territorial defence brigades have been neutralised near Bititsa, Vakalovshchina, and Radkovka (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 175 troops, five motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two AFU mechanised brigades and one territorial defence brigade close to Prosyanka (Kharkov region), Mayaki (Donetsk People's Republic), and Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 200 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 17 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Losses were inflicted on formations of four mechanised brigades and one assault regiment of the AFU close to Druzhkovka, Kramatorsk, Novoselovka, Slavyansk, and Cherevkovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 130 troops, 16 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
⏩
Units of the Tsentr Group of Forces continue to carry out active offensive operations.
Russian troops hit manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one assault brigade, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one national guard brigade close to Kuritsyno, Novoiverskoye, Ocheretino, and Sergeyevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 335 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, seven motor vehicles, one self-propelled artillery system, and two electronic warfare stations.
🚩
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depths of the enemy's defence and liberated Tersyanka in Zaporozhye region as a result of active actions.
💥
Manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one air assault brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU have been hit near Podgavrilovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Novorozovka, and Odarovka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 215 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, one artillery gun, and five motor vehicles.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
The Group's units inflicted losses on the formations of one AFU mechanised brigade and one territorial defence brigade near Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region) and Zaporozhye.
▪️
Up to 30 Ukrainian troops, one tank, one armoured fighting vehicle, 15 motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage
on the power and transport infrastructure used for the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, unmanned aerial vehicles, their storage and launch sites, ammunition depots, as well as temporary deployment areas of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in 142 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
231 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total,
since the beginning of the special military operation,
the enemy has lost
:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
287,451
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
31,641
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,796
MLRS fighting vehicles,
▫️
36,927
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
77,177
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
